lead.title: Google Research Cogentic produces new proofs on five open problems in theoretical computer science
lead.summary: Cogentic, a multi-agent system from Google Research, started from bare problem statements with no expert hints and produced five new verified results on open problems in online learning, auction theory and mechanism design. The system runs orchestrator, prover, summarizer, adversarial verifier, auditor and process-advisor agents over iterative rounds — a notable step for automated proof discovery in theory, not just applied ML.

top_stories.title: Sam Altman confirms deep OpenAI-Cerebras partnership focused on inference speed
top_stories.summary: OpenAI's CEO says the two companies are working closely to push the frontiers of inference and compute speed.

top_stories.title: Meta open sources SDK for building your own Muse AI gadgets
top_stories.summary: Developers can connect Meta's Muse AI agent to ESP32 boards, Raspberry Pi displays and sensors — and 5,000 free 'Muse Home Link' gadgets ship this month.

top_stories.title: Hugging Face opens multi-harness RL for coding agents: 7 trained models, TRL trainer, proxy — all public
top_stories.summary: A fully open recipe for RL-training coding agents across four API harnesses; Liquid AI's LFM2.5-2.6B jumped from 42% to 54% trained on 4 harnesses at once, with 31% fewer tool calls.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA introduces 64GB DGX Spark configuration for local AI developers
top_stories.summary: Partner builds from Acer, ASUS, Dell, Gigabyte, HP and MSI arrive Oct. 23, with a new Sync Cluster Assistant for clustering multiple Sparks.

items.title: Where-OPD: spatially guided on-policy self-distillation of MLLMs with synthetic scenes
items.summary: Trains a multimodal student against an EMA teacher that receives privileged spatial information, improving spatial reasoning.

items.title: CARM: cancellation-aware response masking for LLM reinforcement learning
items.summary: Filters cancelled or failed rollouts in RL post-training, improving training stability and benchmark results on math and code.

items.title: Asynchronous LLM post-training: group-mass capping and convergence analysis
items.summary: Gives theoretical guarantees for asynchronous RL post-training with stale rollouts, proposing group-mass capping as a correction.

items.title: Feature selective model collapse in diffusion models
items.summary: Shows collapse from training on synthetic data is feature-selective: some semantic features degrade while others persist, depending on the training regime.

items.title: Scaling and distilling text embeddings for better diffusibility
items.summary: Finds that scaling the embedding model improves the latent-space 'diffusibility' for continuous diffusion language models, and proposes distilled embeddings optimized for it.

items.title: Together AI and Ollama: evaluating open models against real production traffic, not benchmarks
items.summary: Event sessions on selecting and shortlisting open-weight models in the field, focused on how they hold up against real production traffic rather than standard benchmark suites.

items.title: Karpathy: get better answers out of LLMs with controlled language, diagrams and interactive HTML
items.summary: Request writing in controlled languages like ASD-STE100, ask for diagrams, have the model generate full interactive HTML explainers — with humans focused on oversight.

items.title: Karpathy's geography eval: 'Land or Water?' across 16k+ coordinate queries
items.summary: Models perform well on raw latitude/longitude queries, attributed to internet-scale compression of geographic knowledge rather than lookup.

items.title: Astribot brings T1 humanoid robot to North America at IROS 2026
items.summary: The Chinese humanoid maker debuted its T1 with an integrated physical-AI stack: continuously improving models, an embodied OS, and a cable-driven body.

items.title: Trane adds two 250 MW AI factory cooling reference designs built on NVIDIA DSX platform
items.summary: High-density, liquid-cooled hyperscale deployments get packaged thermal-management blueprints.

items.title: Inside Omron's next-generation LD mobile robots
items.summary: Software, safety systems and fleet management are becoming as important as the robot hardware itself in mobile robotics.

items.title: Samsung Exynos 2700 2nm smartphone SoC reportedly enters mass production
items.summary: Samsung's first 2nm flagship mobile chip reportedly enters mass production with yields improved around 10%, setting up on-device AI to rival Snapdragon.

items.title: Suno launches Speech: voice and music generated together in one model
items.summary: Public beta on web and mobile — Suno says it is the first audio model that generates spoken voice and background music as one cohesive track, up to roughly eight minutes.

items.title: ChatGPT adds a virtual changing room for clothing try-ons
items.summary: Globally launched shopping features let users upload a photo to preview apparel in chat — closely mirroring Google's AI try-on tool.

items.title: Show HN: Television, an open source GUI for your agent harness
items.summary: A visual console for monitoring and driving coding-agent harnesses instead of raw terminal output.

items.title: Show HN: Agent Scrub, a scanner for secrets leaked in coding-agent history
items.summary: Scans agent session history and config files for API keys and credentials accidentally written into logs.

items.title: Show HN: figma-server, a bridge for agents blocked by Figma's API hostility
items.summary: A self-hosted server exposing Figma designs to AI coding agents for design-to-code pipelines.

items.title: Green light for Singapore-founded Silicon Box's €1.3B advanced packaging plant in Novara
items.summary: Invitalia authorized the €1.3B silicon photonics and advanced packaging fab — one of the largest deep-tech investments tied to the AI compute supply chain in Italy, with ~1,600 jobs expected.

items.title: ItaliaAperta.it: an AI assistant that simplifies access to Italy's public administration
items.summary: 'Pino', a RAG chatbot over official sources powered by Qwen 3.8-27B via Regolo.ai, answers natural-language questions on PA procedures — and aims to become an agent that completes them.

items.title: AI skills double in Italian job postings, half of demand now comes from non-IT roles
items.summary: Politecnico di Milano's AI Observatory counts ~44,000 2025 postings requesting AI skills, nearly double the prior year, with 48% from marketing, HR, administration and legal functions.

items.title: Aosta Valley launches AiVdA, a free online AI training platform for citizens
items.summary: 24 hours of free online AI courses open to all residents — one of the first regional-level public AI literacy initiatives in Italy.

items.title: Mondadori's PLAI moves from startup accelerator to open-innovation hub
items.summary: After analyzing 1,600+ startups and making around twenty investments, PLAI presented three startups with investments or collaboration evaluations underway.

items.title: General Intuition raises $220M at $6.2B valuation for physical-world AI models
items.summary: New York-based developer of AI models trained on videos and virtual worlds to build skills for physical environments.

items.title: Supabase raises $150M led by GIC and acquires database startup Turso
items.summary: New funding plus an acquisition for the open-source Postgres platform powering AI app development — consolidation in the AI data layer.

items.title: PaleBlueDot AI raises $200M Series C at $3.2B valuation for GPU infrastructure
items.summary: Over 3x its January Series B valuation; claims $5B+ in signed customer contracts, with its B300 cluster in Japan earning Nvidia Exemplar Cloud status.
